note: Card 060's bench visit as the person ran it on 2026-10-13, recorded by the bench seat. Written without `artifact`, like the dry-run record of 2026-10-08, because nothing here is for the store yet. Readings in phase A were taken by the person in the Micro-Manager Device Property Browser and dictated to this seat in chat, with screenshots of the browser for the PFS and the shutter/turret pages; the seat did not read the instrument itself. The configuration loaded in the GUI was the dual-camera file DMD_dualcam_LUNF.cfg, NOT the single-camera file this seat first suggested. Nothing in this file was written to any device, to envelope/ or to approvals/. File name follows the existing seat-date pattern; the kickoff's 'microscope-<seat>' would have doubled the word.

items.fact: Focus-hold (device PFS, Micro-Manager NikonTi2) readings, three properties each time. OFF, never switched on since the configuration loaded: FocusMaintenance Off, PFS Status 0000000000000000, PFS in Range 'Out of Range'. ON and LOCKED (stand showed locked; Refresh several times left the value unchanged): FocusMaintenance On, PFS Status 0000001100001010, PFS in Range 'In Range'. OFF again after having been on (stand showed 'in range, not locked'; Refresh did not change it): FocusMaintenance Off, PFS Status 0000000100000000, PFS in Range 'In Range'. ON BUT STILL SEARCHING was not caught: the stand locks faster than the person could press Refresh, after several tries. PFS LEDIntensity went from 27 to 10 when focus hold was switched on; the person did not change it.
items.how: Person read each value in the Device Property Browser with 'Show read-only' ticked, pressed Refresh after each change of state, and confirmed the 16 digits of PFS Status for the first two states and the third by saying so. The switch was the stand's own. The 'locked' state was confirmed on the stand by the person, not inferred from the property.
items.for_the_person_to_decide: Which readings go into envelope/safety.json as pfs_not_engaged is the person's. What the readings show: FocusMaintenance read Off in both off states and On in the locked state; PFS Status read two different strings in the two off states, so it does not by itself tell off from not-yet-reached. The searching state has no reading, so nothing says whether FocusMaintenance reads On while searching.

items.fact: Both Kinetix cameras (Kinetix_red, Kinetix_blue, both loaded by the dual-camera file) read Port 'Dynamic Range' and ReadoutRate '100MHz 16bit'. The person saturated the image with the transmitted lamp and read a maximum of 65535 ADU from the Micro-Manager histogram, with many pixels saturated. The person first said the readout was '100MHz 12bit' and then corrected it to '100MHz 16bit' on a second look.
items.how: Read from the histogram, not from the image-information Max. Binning and exposure time at the reading were not given. It was not stated whether the maximum was read on one camera or both; the person said the two cameras read the same. The value belongs to this readout mode only (Dynamic Range, 100MHz 16bit); every other Port and ReadoutRate stays a gap. dino-autofocus's record forms are not on this computer, so this reading is recorded here and not cited to them; if dino's form already holds a value, the two should be compared, not merged.
items.binning_and_exposure: Said by the person afterwards: binning 1x1, exposure 30 ms to 100 ms (a range, not one value; which exposure gave the 65535 was not stated).
gaps: which exposure in the 30 to 100 ms range gave the 65535
which camera the 65535 was read on
